mentions.name: OSINTBuddy
mentions.description: OSINTBuddy is an open source intelligence (OSINT) tool with a plugin system. Current work focuses on adding entity attachments to the plugin system and building a wayback machine plugin.
mentions.author: jerlendds

mentions.name: OSINTBuddy
mentions.description: An open-source intelligence (OSINT) platform offering node graphs, data mining, and a plugin system. The project was rewritten in Rust this year and is nearly at feature parity with the original Python version, with work underway on designing the Python plugin system.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://github.com/osintbuddy/osintbuddy - Node graphs, data mining, and plugins. This year I've rewritten the project to learn Rust and we're nearly at feature parity compared to the old Python version (github.com/jerlendds/osintbuddy).
